title: You'll Pay for This

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: You got a lot of nerve talking to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got a lot of nerve talking to me.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Get the drink off your menu and get back to doing what you're supposed to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get the drink off your menu and get back to doing what you're supposed to do.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Food! Focus on your food and continue serving mediocre drinks. I don't need a rival in the drinks sector.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Food! Focus on your food and continue serving mediocre drinks. I don't need a rival in the drinks sector.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: It's my livelihood! What would you do in my position?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's my livelihood! What would you do in my position?
Stop serving them!

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: You're an asshole. This isn't over...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're an asshole. This isn't over...

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Fine, whatever. Let's just let bygones be bygones and go our own ways. I'm done here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, whatever. Let's just let bygones be bygones and go our own ways. I'm done here.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: Oh, I know how to end it. There's always the nuclear option.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I know how to end it. There's always the nuclear option.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: We could make peace here and now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We could make peace here and now.

nodes.speaker: Nola Berg
nodes.text: We draw a line in the sand. I do the drinks, you do the food. And I admit you got the best of me, this time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We draw a line in the sand. I do the drinks, you do the food. And I admit you got the best of me, this time.
What did I do?
All's fair.
Which is what?
Ummm, no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine. But you leave us be, got it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. But you leave us be, got it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fine. But you leave us be, got it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fine. But you leave us be, got it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's just competition.
Compete?
Bye now.
Pleasure doing business with you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never start a war if you don't know how to end it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never start a war if you don't know how to end it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Never start a war if you don't know how to end it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Never start a war if you don't know how to end it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean the Corps?
You've got nothing.
Or what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you want to admit you lost to me, sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you want to admit you lost to me, sure.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you want to admit you lost to me, sure.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you want to admit you lost to me, sure.
